summary: GasLog Partners LP filed a Form 6-K attaching a November 12, 2026 press release declaring routine quarterly distributions on its Series A, B and C Cumulative Redeemable Perpetual Fixed-to-Floating Rate Preference Units. Per-unit amounts are $0.5390625 (Series A), $0.6350530 (Series B) and $0.6020655 (Series C), with a December 8, 2026 record date and December 15, 2026 payment date. No board recommendation, advisor, transaction terms or structural mechanics are disclosed; this is an ordinary cash-distribution announcement, not a special situation. Watch only for future redemption or capital-structure actions affecting the preference units.
